detail.longDescription: Git repositories are made to be cloned, not scraped commit page by commit page. At scale, HTML crawling wastes CPU on rendered pages, creates higher costs for open source hosts, and can lead to proof-of-work checks or rate limits that affect real users first. Clone once. Fetch updates. Use Git as intended. https:// x.com/GitGem/status/2094005395 513880711 # Git # OpenSource # Linux # FOSS # AICrawlers # DevOps # GitGem
